title: RunMetadata
description: Machine-readable metadata written by run_campaign.sh for every benchmark run.

run_id.description: Unique identifier for this run, e.g. 2026-04-19T12-00-00Z-uniform-open-loop-prequal

date_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the run start

git_sha.description: Full git commit SHA at time of run, or 'unknown'

environment.description: Short label for the cluster/environment, e.g. kind-local, kind-multinode, gke-test

duration_seconds.description: Intended test duration in seconds (0 if not specified)

target_rate_rps.description: Target request rate in requests per second (0 if not specified)

workload_manifest.description: Relative path to the workload manifest used, e.g. benchmark/manifests/workload-uniform.yaml

load_script.description: Relative path to the k6 script used, e.g. benchmark/k6/open_loop.js

controller_env.description: Key-value map of relevant controller environment variables or config overrides

backend_env.description: Key-value map of relevant backend environment variables or config overrides
